responsibility: Declares the small lexer used by the `ppg` EBNF/parser-generator tool rather than the main Modula-2 compiler scanner. It defines the parser-generator token enumeration and exports source open/close, character pushback, current-token access, whitespace/comment skipping, reserved-word classification, token advancement and token pushback, and optional debugging control, forming the lexical front end for reading grammar description files.
same_name_distinction: This `.def` file declares the parser-generator lexer interface and its `TokenType` enumeration for `ppg`, but it does not include the reserved-word table, quote-state tracking, or tokenization logic that appear in `bnflex.mod`.
